LanguageData.MakeshiftAnimalArmorHuge.label: makeshift animal armor (huge)
LanguageData.MakeshiftAnimalArmorHuge.description:
Crude animal armor forged from steel plates. Offers a moderate amount of protection, but restricts limb movement.
Fits on animals with a mature body size of 2.4 or greater.
